reviews.name: Michelle Henry
reviews.text:
I did the surf yoga beer egypt trip. It was a phenomenal trip! Everything was planned out once you arrived that it was easy to turn off your brain to relax and enjoy the adventure! It was super action packed with great workouts and yoga, tons of cool history lessons! We ended 8 days on a yacht! Going kite surfing, scuba diving, swimming, beach workouts and beach games! This was easily one of the best trips i have ever been on!
The people on the trip were amazing, everyone had so much fun! Late night parties and dancing! The leaders were even better, continuing to bring the great vibes through out the whole trip! It was the perfect amount of relaxation with working out and adventure!
10/10 recommend a trip with SYB!!!! Best group travel there is! Definitely will be looking for another trip in the near future!

reviews.name: Craig Luzik
reviews.text:
SYB Egypt
What’s not to love about exploring ancient tombs, scuba diving the Red Sea, riding ATVs in the desert, and kite surfing?
I can’t say enough about this experience. The 10 day trip was packed with activities from workouts to beach games to theme nights to sunset yoga on the beach. More incredible than that though, are the people.
We all came into this trip as complete strangers and walked away as a family. Met some amazing people including the 3 leaders, who ensured everything went smoothly and made it an unforgettable experience.
Bucket list item: accomplished. 10/10 recommend.

reviews.name: Lily McMahon
reviews.text:
Surf Yoga Beer Egypt was honestly such an incredible experience, and it truly felt like the stars aligned. The trip flew by, but I genuinely enjoyed every minute we were there. It was the perfect balance of adventure, history, relaxation, and fun. From exploring the Valley of the Kings and Karnak Temple to spending time on the Red Sea, every moment felt unforgettable. This trip was also the perfect introduction to scuba diving or kitesurfing because no experience was needed and all levels were welcomed. It made trying something completely new feel exciting instead of intimidating.

The group of people was amazing, full of laughter and great energy, and our team leaders truly made the experience special. Mantas, Nikki, and Eli were the perfect team organized, welcoming, supportive, and genuinely fun to be around. They did an incredible job making sure everyone felt included and had a great time throughout the entire trip.

reviews.name: Tommy Whitlow
reviews.text: I just got back from the Egypt SYB trip, and it was absolutely incredible! I couldn’t have asked for a better way to explore Egypt. SYB truly outdid themselves with every detail, from visiting iconic temples to riding ATVs, cruising the Red Sea on a massive yacht, kitesurfing, and diving in some of the world’s most famous spots. Everything was planned and executed flawlessly, and it exceeded my expectations in every way. I give SYB a 10/10. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Danielle Balsara
reviews.text:
SYB has got to be the best travel group if you enjoy working out, partying, and meeting amazing people! I came into the trip not knowing anyone and left with knowing some genuinely amazing people who are already becoming my new travel besties! The whole experience felt easy, fun, and welcoming from day one.

Egypt completely exceeded my expectations and I honestly got so much more out of this trip than I thought I would. It was the perfect mix of adventure, relaxing, good food, great conversations, and unforgettable experiences.

Whether you’re traveling solo or going with friends, SYB makes it so easy to connect with people and just enjoy every moment! Mantas, Eli, and Nikki made it an unforgettable trip!

reviews.name: Camrick Clark
reviews.text:
SurfYogaBeer Egypt: 10 days, but it felt like three weeks of adventure.
I went into this trip with high hopes and somehow it still exceeded them. We saw ancient temples, ripped around on quads, scuba dove the Red Sea, and I even learned to kiteboard from scratch. Every day was packed, but it never felt rushed. Just one unforgettable thing after another.
What made it work was the people. The group came together fast and the leaders were the real difference. They were great at literally everything: organized, fun, genuinely good at the activities, and always making sure everyone was having a good time.
If you're on the fence about an SYB trip, this is your sign. I left with new skills, new friends, and a stack of memories I'll be telling stories about for years.

reviews.name: Colleen Evans
reviews.text: Just got back from SYB Egypt and I had an amazing time!  This was my first trip and the leaders made me feel welcome from the beginning.  The other travelers were also friendly and welcoming. I’ve done group tours before but getting a chance to try adventurous activities such as scuba diving for the first time made this trip a memorable one.   I was nervous about a trip with scheduled workouts as I have some lingering injuries but I appreciated the fact that nothing was ever mandatory. The workouts wound up being a highlight for me as well as we got to do different things each day such as beach yoga and volleyball. Already have trip #2 booked.

reviews.name: Ariel Hernandez
reviews.text: Egypt was never one of those places that was on my bucket list, but the universe decided to pull me in that direction and I couldn't turn down the opportunity. It was a fun filled and adventure packed week, and no better way to experience this part of the world than with strangers who become good friends while having type 2 fun in and around the water!! I wouldn't have done a trip to this region of the world any other way! SYB has become apart of making travel simple and a way to build meaningful connections with people who have similar interests that I wouldn't otherwise have had a chance to get to know. I wholeheartedly believe that if you're living your life on standby, waiting for your friends or "the right time" to do something... You'll continue to live an unfulfilled and dull life, and I would HIGHLY encourage you to embrace the "Don't Think, Just Do" lifestyle. Take the risk. Book that next trip.

reviews.name: Liat Abramove
reviews.text:
Probably one of the best experiences of my life. First trip was in Japan and knew I had to book another trip. Just coming off my second trip in Nicaragua. Such awesome vibes- workouts, great food and surfing.
Made some new friends and got some awesome pictures. Ive done some research with other companies and nothing is as legit as SYB. Can’t wait to head to Egypt in the spring!

reviews.name: Melissa Smith
reviews.text: If you're not sure, book! I felt intimidated booking with Surf Yoga Beer as have never done group travel but wanted to go to Egypt and wanted to have some physical activity in addition to the sightseeing. (That said, I am not super fit... another reason for my initial intimidation!). From the moment I walked into the hotel lobby on Day 1, I was stuck by how friendly, interesting, and fun everyone was. I immediately felt comfortable, welcomed, and inspired. The leaders had excellent energy and created a space where bonding happened naturally and fast. It probably helped that you couldn't put together a better group of people if you tried. I think that just speaks to the magic that is SYB and their leaders. As we were in Egypt, there were definitely some unexpected twists (like hot air ballooning being pushed a day). Duncan and Alex rolled with it and made sure we were all having fun and seeing/experiencing what we wanted to see and experience. And we made it into the hot air balloons over the temple of Hatshepsut after all, which was breath-taking. Totally recommend, just book if you are considering it. You'll meet wonderful people and have once in a lifetime experiences (captured by a professional photographer). Trying to decide which SYB trip to go on next.

reviews.name: Dave Miller
reviews.text: I’ve done two trips with them, Nicaragua and Egypt! It’s a Great time.  Pack more sunscreen than you think you need. You’re constantly doing something outside.  The themes parties, guides tours, and full arranged accumulations make traveling somewhere new super easy

reviews.name: Katie Spanos
reviews.text: SYB Egypt was easily one of the best trips I have ever been on! I was familiar with SYB from Instagram and knowing some people who had been on trips, but never thought I would end up going. Once the Egypt trip was posted, I jumped at the opportunity because it is somewhere I have always wanted to travel. I was skeptical of traveling with a large group, but it ended up being so much more fun! Everyone was so friendly, welcoming, and adventurous. I went home feeling like I had a whole group of new friends! The trip itself was also amazing - there was a good mix of touring historical sites in the desert and then relaxing at a beachside resort. I'd recommend SYB to anyone who loves travel, movement, and meeting amazing new people!
